title: 11.39% gains in one week.
author: Zephyr_Labs
selftext:
After rigorous months of handling one fucking problem after another, I finally had a solid week of not touching the damn system and watching it run from market open to market close.

After 20 ish trades it won 86% of the time and netted over 10% after trading costs. 

We will see if it can do it again next week.

comments.author: Weird_Cookie1700
comments.body: How are you handling the exit logic?

replies.author: Zephyr_Labs
replies.body:
It’s not a fixed take-profit / stop-loss model.  
Every position enters with a defined **invalidation condition and maximum life**.  
If the answer becomes no, it exits.  
The exact conditions and thresholds are part of the proprietary logic, so I keep those private.
